about_the_game:
Experience the thrill of combat with a unique roster of characters, each with their own technical and thoughtful move sets designed for both casual players and competitive fighters alike. Master your character’s abilities and outplay your opponents in intense platform battles.

Whether you're battling friends locally or challenging players online, Bam Bam Boom offers endless fun and competitive game play.

Key Features
  • Unique characters: Choose from a diverse set of characters, each with unique abilities and strategies
  • Technical Move Sets: Discover deep, thoughtful move sets that reward skill and timing
  • Online Multiplayer: Battle against friends and players from all over the world in online matches
  • Local Multiplayer: Gather your friends and engage in local battles for ultimate bragging rights
  • Custom Games: Create your own rules and settings for a unique fighting experience
  • Challenges: Test your skills in a variety of exciting challenges against opponents who will push your limits

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Fight your way to glory in this intense platform fighter. Master the manoeuvres of a unique roster of characters and utilise strategies to strike your opponent like Bam. Bam. Boom!
